record_paths.description: Files or directories to observe before and after this command, relative to workdir or absolute. Copies existing regular files before launch and records creations, changes and deletions for version-checked undo. Include expected output paths, including missing files. Observation is limited to these paths; concurrent outside edits cannot be attributed to this command.
record_paths.title: Record Paths

tty.description: Start a real interactive terminal (Windows ConPTY), with merged ANSI output. Returns a persistent session even when yield_time_ms is omitted.
tty.title: Tty

yield_time_ms.description: Start a persistent command session and wait this many integer milliseconds; 1000 means one second.
yield_time_ms.title: Yield Time Ms
